Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, CC immunity, Seiton, warnings, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating a sharp HOWMANY-style pressure counter, stable native-nameplate pressure and CC-protection cues, Ninja Seiton decisions, configurable personal and MCH LB warnings with sound, opt-in CC-only one-shot Near Assist and Purify helpers, plus target highlights.
Changelog: Integrated a sharp HOWMANY-style pressure counter, enemy P#/incoming badges, stable nameplate CC-protection icons and countdowns, a larger MCH LB warning with built-in sound, warning opacity, and a seven-tab UI. Near Assist is now a 750 ms CC-only, Turbo-compatible one-shot with optional team-pressure preference and a targetless <me> carrier plus <t> fallback. Configuration schema 10.
